create_task: create a length generalization task using constants.TASK_BUILDERS with a task name like even_pairs
build_model: build a neural network model from constants.MODEL_BUILDERS with architecture params and output size
run_training: run a training worker with training.TrainingWorker and ClassicTrainingParams to train and evaluate the network
test_model: test the trained model with range test evaluation across sequence lengths up to max_range_test_length
summarize_curriculum: summarize a UniformCurriculum that defines training sequence lengths from 1 to sequence_length
